outer_protocol: 4x4 positive-negative trial pairs; 30 train / 10 validation windows
inner_protocol: 3x3 positive-negative trial pairs; 20 train / 10 validation windows
aggregation: mean five windows, then mean four pair probabilities per trial
quota_source: 数据/数据集说明文档.md: each subject has four neutral and four positive physical trials
quota_tie_break: ascending trial_index (fixed input order), never labels
compute: CPU: preserve experiment 106 scipy/sklearn solvers; no equivalent GPU backend in this implementation
